extra.final_summary: The data had three main issues affecting the question: (1) 'species' column had misspellings ('Adeile') and extra spaces (' Chinstrap'), which were merged into the allowed labels using normalize_labels; (2) 'sex' column had uppercase variants ('MALE', 'FEMALE'), which were normalized to lowercase; (3) 'body_mass_g' was stored as text with commas, so it was converted to numbers. Additionally, three rows had body mass values (3,750,000, 5,400,000, 5,350,000) that were far above the allowed maximum of 6,500 grams and were excluded as likely data entry errors. After these fixes, the average body mass was calculated as 3,946.30 grams for females and 4,412.90 grams for males.
